name: parse
description: Parse Biosciences Evercode-style combinatorial indexing data.

halt_guidance.blocker: Parse Evercode combinatorial indexing requires kit-specific barcode lists and a sample/library manifest that cannot be reconstructed reliably from public FASTQs alone.
required_inputs: Parse sample/library manifest, barcode resources, and matching reference
next_steps: Identify the Evercode kit version and obtain the corresponding split-pipe resources.
Reconstruct and verify the sample/library manifest from depositor supplements or methods.
Run split-pipe and archive the manifest, command, and resulting count matrix.

recommended_workflows.name: Parse Biosciences split-pipe
recommended_workflows.role: Kit-aware combinatorial-barcode parsing and matrix generation

halt_guidance.resume: Use split-pipe output downstream; UniScFlow does not infer missing Parse manifests or barcode resources.
